comment: Token-drift guardrail (UX professional redesign §5.3). Forbids raw hex in component <style> blocks so color flows through tokens.css. Slice 0 lands this report-only (severity: warning → exits 0); Slice 1 removes the override to make it blocking once the 57 offenders are migrated. tokens.css/base.css are intentionally NOT linted (they are the source of truth for raw values).

color-no-hex.message: Raw hex forbidden in component styles — use a token from tokens.css (var(--color-*)). See .loom/21-ux-professional-redesign.md §5.3.
